summary: Thread with a large stack array that overflows the default QNX pthread stack but not the Linux one
issue:
vibmon runs fine on our Linux test rig, but on the QNX target it dies right after start:

    # ./vibmon
    vibmon: analysing 65536 samples (seed 42)
    Memory fault (core dumped)

On Linux the same source prints `rms=0.879203 peak=1.979275` for the default run. We need the same results on QNX. We built it with `make` in task/vibmon and ran it from /tmp on the target.
